question: Should OpenClaw resolve this memory consistency issue through the open multi-slot role architecture, through a narrower `memory.backend`/`memoryFlush` consolidation, or through the Memory MVP schema/CRUD direction instead?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes durable public config and plugin API boundaries plus migration behavior, which automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Review the role-slot architecture first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the primary architecture path, then map or split this issue's remaining backend/flush/storage concerns after that decision.

options.title: Narrow this issue to backend and flush semantics
options.body: Keep this issue as a smaller config/docs/doctor task only for builtin/QMD/memoryFlush consistency, separate from broader multi-slot memory composition.

options.title: Fold into Memory MVP design
options.body: Treat this as dependent on the typed memory schema and operator surface issues instead of changing the current backend/slot model directly.

recommendation.title: Review the role-slot architecture first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the primary architecture path, then map or split this issue's remaining backend/flush/storage concerns after that decision.
